name: Math & statistics
description: Evaluate formulas, round precisely, summarise numbers, compute percentiles, compound interest and loan schedules, and convert units.

operations.label: Evaluate formula
operations.description: Evaluate an arithmetic formula with + - * / % ^ and parentheses, variables from an object and the functions abs, round, floor, ceil, sqrt, min, max, pow, log, ln, exp, sin, cos and tan (constants pi and e). Never runs code.

inputs.name: expression
inputs.label: Formula
inputs.description: For example (price * qty) * (1 + tax_rate) - discount. Variable names may be dotted paths into Variables (order.total). ^ is power, % is remainder; log(x) is base 10, log(x, b) base b, ln(x) natural.

inputs.name: variables
inputs.label: Variables
inputs.description: The values the formula uses, as an object: { "price": 19.99, "qty": 3 }. Numeric text is accepted.

inputs.name: decimals
inputs.label: Round to decimals
inputs.description: Optional: round the result to this many decimal places (half up). Leave empty for the full result.

outputs.name: result
outputs.label: Result
outputs.description: The value of the formula.

operations.label: Round
operations.description: Round a number to a number of decimal places with an explicit rounding mode. Decimal-exact: 1.005 rounds to 1.01.

inputs.name: value
inputs.label: Value
inputs.description: The number to round.

inputs.name: decimals
inputs.label: Decimals
inputs.description: Decimal places (0 for whole numbers; negative rounds to tens, hundreds…).

inputs.name: mode
inputs.label: Mode
inputs.description: How to round a value that sits between two results.

outputs.name: result
outputs.label: Result
outputs.description: The rounded number.

operations.label: Statistics
operations.description: Descriptive statistics for a list of numbers (or a field of a list of objects): count, sum, mean, min, max, median, mode, variance, standard deviation and range.

inputs.name: values
inputs.label: Values
inputs.description: The numbers: a list of numbers (or numeric text), or a list of objects with Field naming the number. Blank entries are skipped.

inputs.name: field
inputs.label: Field
inputs.description: When Values is a list of objects: the property holding the number (dotted paths such as amount.total work).

inputs.name: variance_type
inputs.label: Variance
inputs.description: Sample (n - 1, for a sample of a larger population) or population (n, for the whole set).

outputs.name: count
outputs.label: Count
outputs.description: How many numbers there are (blank entries are skipped).

outputs.name: mean
outputs.label: Mean
outputs.description: The average (empty when there are no numbers).

outputs.name: median
outputs.label: Median
outputs.description: The middle value (the average of the two middle values for an even count).

outputs.name: mode
outputs.label: Mode
outputs.description: The most frequent value (the smallest if several tie); empty when no value repeats.

outputs.name: variance
outputs.label: Variance
outputs.description: Sample variance needs at least 2 numbers.

outputs.name: range
outputs.label: Range
outputs.description: Maximum minus minimum.

operations.label: Percentile
operations.description: The p-th percentile of a list of numbers, with linear interpolation between the closest ranks (the same as Excel PERCENTILE.INC).

inputs.name: values
inputs.label: Values
inputs.description: The numbers: a list of numbers (or numeric text), or a list of objects with Field naming the number. Blank entries are skipped.

inputs.name: field
inputs.label: Field
inputs.description: When Values is a list of objects: the property holding the number (dotted paths such as amount.total work).

inputs.name: p
inputs.label: Percentile
inputs.description: From 0 to 100: 50 is the median, 90 the 90th percentile.

outputs.name: value
outputs.label: Value
outputs.description: The percentile.

outputs.name: count
outputs.label: Count
outputs.description: How many numbers were used.

operations.label: Compound interest
operations.description: Grow a starting amount with compound interest and optional regular contributions; returns the future value and a year-by-year schedule.

inputs.name: principal
inputs.label: Starting amount
inputs.description: The amount invested at the start.

inputs.name: annual_rate
inputs.label: Annual rate (%)
inputs.description: Nominal annual interest rate in percent, e.g. 5 for 5%.

inputs.name: years
inputs.label: Years
inputs.description: How many years (1 to 100).

inputs.name: compounds_per_year
inputs.label: Compounding periods per year
inputs.description: 1 yearly, 4 quarterly, 12 monthly, 52 weekly, 365 daily.

inputs.name: contribution
inputs.label: Contribution per period
inputs.description: Optional amount added every compounding period (e.g. monthly when compounding monthly).

inputs.name: contribution_timing
inputs.label: Contributions at
inputs.description: Whether contributions are added at the start or the end of each period.

outputs.name: future_value
outputs.label: Future value
outputs.description: The balance at the end, rounded to 2 decimals.

outputs.name: total_contributions
outputs.label: Total contributions
outputs.description: The starting amount plus every contribution.

outputs.name: interest_earned
outputs.label: Interest earned
outputs.description: Future value minus total contributions.

outputs.name: schedule
outputs.label: Schedule by year
outputs.description: One row per year.

fields.name: balance
fields.label: Balance
fields.description: At the end of the year.

operations.label: Loan schedule
operations.description: Monthly amortisation schedule for a fixed-rate loan: the payment (P·r / (1 − (1 + r)^−n)), each period's interest and principal, the balance, totals and the payoff date. Extra payments shorten the loan.

inputs.name: principal
inputs.label: Loan amount
inputs.description: The amount borrowed.

inputs.name: annual_rate
inputs.label: Annual rate (%)
inputs.description: Nominal annual interest rate in percent (0 for an interest-free loan).

inputs.name: term_months
inputs.label: Term (months)
inputs.description: Number of monthly payments (1 to 600), e.g. 360 for 30 years.

inputs.name: start_date
inputs.label: First payment date
inputs.description: Optional: the date of the first payment; later payments fall on the same day of each month (the last day in shorter months).

inputs.name: extra_payment
inputs.label: Extra payment per month
inputs.description: Optional extra principal paid with every payment.

outputs.name: payment
outputs.label: Monthly payment
outputs.description: The regular payment (the last one may be smaller).

outputs.name: total_paid
outputs.label: Total paid
outputs.description: Principal plus interest.

outputs.name: number_of_payments
outputs.label: Number of payments
outputs.description: Fewer than the term when extra payments are made.

outputs.name: payoff_date
outputs.label: Payoff date
outputs.description: The date of the last payment (empty without a first payment date).

outputs.name: schedule
outputs.label: Schedule
outputs.description: One row per payment.

operations.label: Convert units
operations.description: Convert a value between units of length, mass, volume, temperature, area, speed, data size and time.

inputs.name: value
inputs.label: Value
inputs.description: The amount to convert.

inputs.name: from
inputs.label: From unit
inputs.description: Symbol or name: mm cm m km in ft yd mi nmi · mg g kg t oz lb st · ml l m3 tsp tbsp floz cup pt qt gal gal_uk · C F K · m2 km2 ha ac ft2 · m/s km/h mph kn · bit B kB MB GB TB KiB MiB GiB Mb Gb · ms s min h d wk mo yr.

inputs.name: to
inputs.label: To unit
inputs.description: A unit of the same kind as From unit.

outputs.name: result
outputs.label: Result
outputs.description: The converted value (12 significant digits).

outputs.name: category
outputs.label: Category
outputs.description: length, mass, volume, temperature, area, speed, data or time.

summary: Numeric building blocks for workflows: a safe formula evaluator with variables, rounding with banker's and other modes, descriptive statistics, percentiles, compound interest, loan amortisation schedules and unit conversion.
purpose: Do the arithmetic a workflow needs in one step, with exact rounding and clear errors, instead of chaining Calculate Value nodes.
recommended_for: Finance approvals, quotes, loan and savings illustrations, KPI summaries, measurements and any step that needs reliable numbers.
setup_notes: Pure computation: no network, data or secrets. Nothing to configure after installing.
Money amounts in compound interest and loan schedules are rounded to 2 decimal places (half up) per period; the final loan payment absorbs the rounding so the balance ends at exactly 0.
author: UserTasks
